GDS.blurb: China's leading carrier-neutral data center provider; its overseas business operates as DayOne.
GDS.blurb_zh: 中国领先的运营商中立数据中心服务商；其海外业务以DayOne品牌运营。

NTT Global Data Centers.blurb: One of the world's top-three colocation platforms, part of the NTT DOCOMO group.
NTT Global Data Centers.blurb_zh: 全球三大colocation平台之一，隶属于NTT DOCOMO集团。

Equinix.blurb: The world's largest colocation and interconnection provider.
Equinix.blurb_zh: 全球最大的colocation与互联互通服务商。

China Telecom.blurb: One of China's three state-owned carriers, operating a vast IDC footprint nationwide.
China Telecom.blurb_zh: 中国三大国有电信运营商之一，在全国范围内运营庞大的IDC布局。

CDC Data Centres.blurb: Canberra-headquartered operator focused on secure, sovereign-capable facilities across ANZ.
CDC Data Centres.blurb_zh: 总部位于堪培拉的运营商，专注于在澳新地区建设安全、具备主权能力的设施。

AWS.blurb: Amazon's cloud platform — a mix of self-built campuses and wholesale leases across APAC.
AWS.blurb_zh: 亚马逊的云平台——在亚太地区采用自建园区与批发租赁相结合的模式。

STT GDC.blurb: Singapore-based colocation platform with 100+ facilities across Asia and Europe.
STT GDC.blurb_zh: 总部位于新加坡的colocation平台，在亚洲和欧洲拥有100多个设施。

KDDI Telehouse.blurb: KDDI's colocation arm, a fixture of Japan's carrier-neutral interconnection scene.
KDDI Telehouse.blurb_zh: KDDI旗下的colocation业务，是日本运营商中立互联互通领域的常客。

China Mobile.blurb: The world's largest mobile operator, building out cloud and IDC campuses across China.
China Mobile.blurb_zh: 全球最大的移动运营商，正在中国各地建设云和IDC园区。

Digital Realty.blurb: US-listed data center REIT with a global carrier-neutral portfolio.
Digital Realty.blurb_zh: 美国上市的数据中心REIT，拥有全球化的运营商中立资产组合。

Alibaba Cloud.blurb: Alibaba's cloud arm — China's largest public cloud, with self-built campuses nationwide.
Alibaba Cloud.blurb_zh: 阿里巴巴旗下的云业务——中国最大的公有云，在全国建有自建园区。

NEXTDC.blurb: Australia's leading independent colocation provider, expanding into Southeast Asia.
NEXTDC.blurb_zh: 澳大利亚领先的独立colocation服务商，正在向东南亚扩张。

Digital Edge.blurb: Stonepeak-backed platform focused on carrier-dense facilities across Asia.
Digital Edge.blurb_zh: Stonepeak支持的平台，专注于亚洲各地运营商资源密集的设施。

AirTrunk.blurb: Macquarie-backed hyperscale wholesale operator, one of APAC's largest independent platforms.
AirTrunk.blurb_zh: Macquarie支持的hyperscale批发运营商，是亚太地区最大的独立平台之一。

Princeton Digital Group.blurb: Warburg Pincus-backed hyperscale platform spanning China and Southeast Asia.
Princeton Digital Group.blurb_zh: Warburg Pincus支持的hyperscale平台，业务横跨中国和东南亚。

Keppel Data Centres.blurb: The data center arm of Singapore's Keppel Corporation.
Keppel Data Centres.blurb_zh: 新加坡吉宝企业（Keppel Corporation）旗下的数据中心业务。

Microsoft.blurb: Azure's APAC expansion mixes owned campuses, land banks and wholesale leases.
Microsoft.blurb_zh: Azure在亚太的扩张结合了自有园区、土地储备和批发租赁。

STACK.blurb: IPI-backed hyperscale developer-operator, rapidly expanding across APAC markets.
STACK.blurb_zh: IPI支持的hyperscale开发运营商，正在亚太各市场快速扩张。

Huawei Cloud.blurb: Huawei's cloud business, anchored by large self-built campuses in Guizhou and beyond.
Huawei Cloud.blurb_zh: 华为的云业务，以贵州等地的大型自建园区为依托。

Bridge Data Centres.blurb: Chindata's international hyperscale platform serving Southeast Asia and India.
Bridge Data Centres.blurb_zh: Chindata旗下的国际hyperscale平台，服务东南亚和印度市场。

KT.blurb: Korea's incumbent carrier, operating IDCs under the kt cloud brand.
KT.blurb_zh: 韩国主导运营商,以 kt cloud 品牌运营IDC。

China Unicom.blurb: China's second-largest carrier, with a national IDC and cloud network.
China Unicom.blurb_zh: 中国第二大运营商,拥有全国性IDC与云网络。

DCI Indonesia.blurb_zh: 印度尼西亚领先的企业级colocation提供商。

Tencent Cloud.blurb: Tencent's cloud arm, anchored by mega-campuses like Gui'an Seven Star.
Tencent Cloud.blurb_zh: Tencent的云业务,以贵安七星等超大型园区为依托。

Google.blurb: Google Cloud's APAC footprint — self-built campuses in Singapore, Japan and Taiwan.
Google.blurb_zh: Google Cloud的亚太布局——在新加坡、日本和台湾自建园区。

Global Switch.blurb: Long-standing carrier-neutral operator with landmark facilities in Singapore, Sydney and Hong Kong.
Global Switch.blurb_zh: 历史悠久的carrier-neutral运营商,在新加坡、悉尼和香港拥有标志性设施。

Colt Data Centre Services.blurb: Fidelity-backed operator with deep roots in Japan's enterprise colocation market.
Colt Data Centre Services.blurb_zh: Fidelity投资的运营商,深耕日本企业级colocation市场。

Vocus Communications.blurb: Australian telco and fiber operator with a national data center network.
Vocus Communications.blurb_zh: 澳大利亚电信和光纤运营商,拥有全国性数据中心网络。

Naver.blurb: Korea's largest internet company, building hyperscale campuses for its cloud platform.
Naver.blurb_zh: 韩国最大的互联网公司,正为其云平台建设hyperscale园区。

ESR Group.blurb: APAC's largest logistics-real-estate developer, now a major data center developer-landlord.
ESR Group.blurb_zh: 亚太最大的物流地产开发商,现已成为重要的数据中心开发商兼业主。

Goodman Group.blurb: Global industrial property group developing powered-shell campuses for hyperscale tenants.
Goodman Group.blurb_zh: 全球性工业地产集团,为hyperscale租户开发供电壳体(powered-shell)园区。

Vantage Data Centers.blurb: DigitalBridge-backed hyperscale wholesale platform with APAC campuses in Japan, Australia, Malaysia and Taiwan.
Vantage Data Centers.blurb_zh: DigitalBridge投资的hyperscale批发平台,在日本、澳大利亚、马来西亚和台湾设有亚太园区。

DayOne.blurb: GDS's international arm, rebranded from GDS International in 2025 — Singapore-based hyperscale platform expanding across Southeast Asia, Japan and Europe.
DayOne.blurb_zh: GDS的国际业务,2025年由GDS International更名而来——总部位于新加坡的hyperscale平台,业务扩展至东南亚、日本和欧洲。

VNET.blurb: Nasdaq-listed carrier-neutral IDC operator, one of China's largest third-party data center providers.
VNET.blurb_zh: 纳斯达克上市的carrier-neutral IDC运营商,中国最大的第三方数据中心提供商之一。

EdgeConneX.blurb: EQT-backed colocation operator spanning edge to hyperscale, with a growing APAC footprint including Indonesia.
EdgeConneX.blurb_zh: EQT投资的colocation运营商,业务覆盖从edge到hyperscale,亚太布局不断扩张,包括印度尼西亚。

Oracle.blurb: Database and cloud giant pouring capex into GPU-dense OCI regions, with Stargate-scale AI ambitions.
Oracle.blurb_zh: 数据库与云巨头,正向GPU密集的OCI区域大举投入资本开支,并怀有Stargate规模的AI雄心。

Meta.blurb: Facebook's parent; one of the world's largest data center builders and a major APAC capacity lessee.
Meta.blurb_zh: Facebook的母公司;全球最大的数据中心建设者之一,也是亚太地区的主要容量承租方。

CoreWeave.blurb: The largest pure-play AI neocloud; NVIDIA-backed hyperscale GPU capacity on long-term contracts.
CoreWeave.blurb_zh: 最大的纯正AI neocloud;NVIDIA支持的hyperscale GPU容量,以长期合约运营。

Nebius.blurb: Amsterdam-based AI cloud spun out of Yandex, scaling GPU capacity across Europe and the US.
Nebius.blurb_zh: 总部位于阿姆斯特丹的AI云公司,从Yandex分拆而来,正在欧洲和美国扩展GPU容量。

Lambda.blurb: US GPU cloud provider serving AI labs and enterprises, expanding into large-scale campuses.
Lambda.blurb_zh: 美国GPU云服务商,服务AI实验室和企业客户,正向大规模园区扩张。

Crusoe.blurb: AI infrastructure builder that started on stranded energy; now developing hyperscale GPU campuses.
Crusoe.blurb_zh: 从搁浅能源起步的AI基础设施开发商,目前正在开发hyperscale GPU园区。

IREN.blurb: Australian-listed bitcoin miner turned AI cloud operator, converting power-rich sites into GPU data centers.
IREN.blurb_zh: 澳大利亚上市的比特币矿企转型为AI云运营商,将电力资源丰富的站点改造为GPU数据中心。

Applied Digital.blurb: US developer of purpose-built AI data centers, anchored by long-term neocloud leases.
Applied Digital.blurb_zh: 美国定制化AI数据中心开发商,以长期neocloud租约为支撑。

Fluidstack.blurb: GPU cloud provider partnering with governments and labs on sovereign AI capacity.
Fluidstack.blurb_zh: 与各国政府及实验室合作建设主权AI算力的GPU云服务商。

GMI Cloud.blurb: Taiwan-rooted GPU cloud operating AI data centers across the US and Asia.
GMI Cloud.blurb_zh: 根植于台湾的GPU云服务商,在美国和亚洲多地运营AI数据中心。

Firmus Technologies.blurb: Tasmanian AI infrastructure pioneer behind Sustainable Metal Cloud; listed on the ASX in 2026.
Firmus Technologies.blurb_zh: 塔斯马尼亚AI基础设施先驱,Sustainable Metal Cloud的幕后公司;于2026年在ASX上市。

SharonAI.blurb: Australian neocloud building sovereign GPU capacity with local partners.
SharonAI.blurb_zh: 澳大利亚neocloud企业,与本地合作伙伴共建主权GPU算力。

SoftBank.blurb: Japanese telco-turned-AI-infrastructure group: SoftBank Corp operates domestic DCs and the Sakai AI campus, while SoftBank Group backs Stargate-scale AI investments.
SoftBank.blurb_zh: 由电信运营商转型为AI基础设施集团的日本企业:SoftBank Corp运营日本国内数据中心及Sakai AI园区,而SoftBank Group则支持Stargate级别的AI投资。
